question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: raise

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• **Raise **means to increase the level of something or to make something better or stronger.
 
• **Rising **means increasing in size, amount, quality, or strength; moving higher compared to previous levels.
 
• Raising is the gerund or present participle of Raise.
 
• **Rise **means to move up from a lower to a higher position.
 
 
 
• We use '**to' with verbs** to indicate the person or thing that receives or experiences the object of the verb.
 
• **"To"** always takes the base form (verb 1) of the verb.
 
• In the given passage **"fund"** is mentioned. We know that **Fund-raising** is the activity of collecting money to support a charity or political campaign or organization.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 1.

Complete Paragraph: *The Covid-19 pandemic has deeply affected people across the world. During these difficult (1) times __frontline workers have been at the highest risk as __(2) they __have been stepping out to work daily __(3) without __proper protective gear. An NGO reached out to people to **__(4) raise__** funds to procure PPE kits, masks and sanitizers for (5)______ among the frontline workers. Several school children participated (6)______ this noble initiative. They collected old newspapers and books and (7)______ them to raise a good sum of money which was (8)______ used to buy kits. The children were happy to (9)______ and learnt how taking care of each other is very (10)______ in such challenging situations.*
